notes.title: v1.3.29
notes.notes:
v1.3.29
- Add lucy-edit support to fal AI plugin (edit videos with prompt)
- Add 'Show effects' to audio plugin items context menu, allowing you to
  access basic editing of audio items generated with AI
- Improved item selection responsivenes: you no longer have to wiggle
  the mouse to select item when pressing S. If you are already hovering over item, 
  pressing S is enough
- Fix issue where adding fade in/out to audio might cause rendering to fail
  when start / end was modified
- Fix crashes of some rares cases of app saving files and system blocking the operation

As always, update your plugins also, to try out the new plugins :)

notes.title: v1.3.28
notes.notes:
- Google 'Nano banana' support! Use with your Google Ai studio API key 
  (free tier also works!!!) (UPDATE YOUR PLUGINS!!!)
- Font/primitive stroke color and effects can now be defined

notes.title: v1.3.26
notes.notes:
v1.3.26
- Fix issue where prev/next payload items did not show properly 
  after opening project
- Improved project load time on big projects with lot's of audio
- Local stable diffusion seed issue fixed
- Reference image in Stable diffusion Flux Kontext also available 
  in item payload

notes.title: v1.3.22
notes.notes:
- Fixed video clip trimming, when start of the item was adjusted
- FalAi integration, nearly DOUBLING the amount of video models LVS
  now supports. Use multiple models with signel access token
- Stable diffusion plugin now has correct default value for seed
- Fixed issue where hidden video tracks would still apply their sound to the video
- Fixed issue where audio with start offset was not applied to end result properly
- Fix issue rendering not disposing items properly on exit, leading to a memory
  leak / very slow rendering next time
- Fix issue of value effect fade in not working is using relative time AND 
  'Reverse to end'-feauture
- DropBox content delivery no longer times out
- Added more progress indication. Added indicator to show when it's still uploading...
- Can now upload files over 150mb to dropbox

notes.title: v1.3.21
notes.notes:
- Runway ML Aleph support: edit videos with reference text and images
- Fix issue with timeline getting hidden whan changing between different 
  sized monitors
- Reset view in settings menu now resets the heigth of render view as well
- Small optimization to video thumbnails after previous patch thumbnail
  refactor
- Fix potential crash in Chatterbox plugin initialization
- Fix random crash when loading plugins and plugin preset if opened in other application
- Fix crash when sanitizing DeepSeek output
- Closing the projext while video items are caching will now cancel the operation

notes.title: v1.3.15
notes.notes:
- Loading... does not longer jump to screen when splitting audio and video
- IMPORTANT! Split quick key (shift) now requires double tap to split the item
  This change prevents overlapping functions of drag/snapping items with shift
- New item is no longer opened to side panel when split happens
- Fixed issue where splitting long video file to smaller pieces would result 
  in slow project start time and increased memory usage
- Fixed 'Rebuild cache' feature resetting video boundaries, 'Rebuild cache' also available
  for individual items (context menu)
- Fixed video thumbnails being out of sync for videos with different framerate
  than project framerate

notes.title: Plugin update! Also with WAN 2.2 local mode
notes.notes:
v1.3.7
- WAN 2.2 video API integrated (Alibaba cloud)!!!!
- WAN 2.2 Local video integrated!!! (trail & full)
- ElevenLabs text-to-speech!!!
- ElevenLabs audio-to-text!!!
- Minimax text-to-speech new models
- Minimax music
- Fixed video metadata not displaying on video plugin item edit, when available
- Show audio/video file size in item settings
- Fixed issue when changing app to different sized screen and timeline went awol
- Videos can now be played backwards (without loop pingpong)
- Fixed prev/next generation in audio plugin edit
- Multiedit / plugin edit text boxes now allows new line

notes.title: v1.3.1: Back to the videos
notes.notes:
- Runway ML to support video upscale (up tp 40sec) and ACT2
- Luma AI DreamMachine video edit support
- Fix issue where DropBox upload errors were not visible to users
- You can copy the frame of the video in playhead position from video
  item context menu. Paste it then to some plugin as source, for example
- You can now trim the video clips to the item boundaries: 
  usefull for video-to-video services (cost reduction, max lenght limitations)
- Plugin views now support hiding of properties based on other values
  (for example, hiding redundant properties for certain models, when single plugin
  handles multiple ways to generate stuff)
- Image sources in plugin views now immediately refreshed when editing
- Fix issue with local audio-to-text extraction inserting new items to start of the timeline
  instead of item start, in "split words"-mode
- Timeline & renderview heigth is now preserved to project file
  and applied on project load
- Fix crash when trying to open project archive from invalid url

Remember to update your plugins!!!

notes.title: v1.2.35 Let the be sound
notes.notes:
v1.2.35
- Flux Kontext & chroma support (integrated stable diffusion, full version only)
- MusicGpt service integrated, see homepages for more instructions
- Minimax support new video model, MiniMax-Hailuo-02
- Minimax text-to-speech support
- Dropdowns in plugin item edits now support searching: 
  Just type something when the dropdown is opened
- Extract text from audio now supports OpenAi API (also LITE version)
- Fix crash when trying to save project to folder that is not writeable
- Support for generative audio plugins finalized
- Fix issue where you could not open context menu on 
  muted audio clip
- Fixed issue of plugin setting not saved when changed from edit view expander (again)
- Copy to sub folder no longer skips copying for items that are under same folder
  as the saved project file
- Custom marker no longer invisible on timeline
- Lyric split dialog now works as it should
- Fix issue where file dropped to plugin field could not be replaced with
  second drop
- Progress ETA in plugin item views now works when the progress is reset
- Mask now renders correctly when render view is scaled down (was not affecting
  actual rendering)
- Fix crash that would occur if plugin settings save failed

notes.title: v1.2.26
notes.notes:
- Karaoke mode now possible. See homepage for instructions
- Text backgrounds: You can now define primitive item as item background
  from font settings. You can also apply effects and shaders to it
- Fix text offset calculation in word-by-word offsetting

notes.title: v1.2.21: Crossfades!!!
notes.notes:
v1.2.21
- Huge crossfade-transition update! 91 new transitions
  are available. You can now choose the transition type in track settings.
  (+ icon on top left of each track, then select "Track effects")
  It will affect overlapping items on that track. Note that if using transitions
  other than opacity crossfade, any other effects for the "next to come" item will
  not be effective, only the effects of "fading out item" are applied
- Fixed issue of issue reporter: all fields came as empty on server side.
  Sorry about that :)

notes.title: v1.2.18
notes.notes:
v1.2.18
- Front page changes
- FramePack plugin tested with F1 support (see homepages for help)
- Framepack plugin now correctly handles the temporary files and the final generation

notes.title: v1.2.23
notes.notes:
- Trial/Demo mode changes: Added watermark, but allow rendering!
  Feature set limited, hard watermark when over limits
- Opt in data collection for paid users: help make Lyric Video Studio better :)
  See general settings
- Fix minor issue of unvisible change in undo-redo stack feature
- Fix crash when splitting empty lyric items
- Temp folder when rendering is not longer deleted on new render
- Fix issue that could fail rendering, when adding audio to video
- FIx issue of using start playback marker would render black frames to beginning

notes.title: v1.2.10
notes.notes:
v1.2.10
- Fix issue that could occur if timeline items were edited while 
  image generating was ongoing for all track items
- Small adjustment to default LLM prompt
- Fix issue of plugin tracks clone not showing the items correctly
- Start-playback marker now works properly when no end marker set
- Can now cancel export
- Improved project load time and export

notes.title: V1.2.6
notes.notes:
- Framepack integration! See home pages for more details. Install
  it manually, point to .bat and then prompt long videos with even 6gb of GPU 
  vram
- Browser view is back
- Fix crash on selecting video file manually
- Couple of more shaders
- Allow to copy all const floats of shader as parameters

notes.title: v1.2
notes.notes:
V1.2 is officially here! A lot of new features compared to 1.1, but here's the latests
- Can now delete shared project file from the project settings
- New controls for item manipulation in render view and settings
  for default mode
- Item binding: you can now bind certain properties to another items.
  In practice, meaning you can make the item follow another item easily
- When splitting or moving start / end of video, the render view will now 
  temporarily render the frame that your mouse is currently hovering on
- Can now de-couple audio item from video
- Plugin names now more human readable, when dropping image
  to timetrack and selecting target plugin
- Multi-edit view now shows names of nested objects
- Google Drive content delivery now supports changing account from
  what was first selected
- Plugin error validation now shows multiple lines and no longer
  bugs out if validations were bit crossed
- Can now copypaste video to plugin tracks that support video import
- Can now copypaste lyrics to plugin tracks that support importing from text
- Fix issue of Drag & Dropping video item to video import enabled plugin track
- Integrated stable diffusion plugin can now download the missing models
  if you chose any of the preset. Plugin instance now also recovers from errors. 
  Sd3.5 now has proper default settings
- General download stuffs now cancellable
- Screenshot no longer renders the ui as well

notes.title: v1.1.20
notes.notes:
- Fixed overly long links in plugin edit view, General Settings
- Small fix to KlingAi error handling & Luma also
- Add support for uploading project archive to cloud for sharing
- Fix issue of project archive not working if project had plugin tracks

notes.title: v1.1.19
notes.notes:
v1.1.19
- 'Import project'-feature: import any project into existing, to the position
  of current playhead
- Image crop plugin localized as well as plugin names (for generic ones)
- Ellipse no longer drawn twice as large as it was defined
- Can now cut the end of looped video
- Fix primitive point manipulation whn scale is not 1
- Fix issue with motion data Y-axis. 
- Video motion data is rendered frame by frame when video item
  is opened in edit
- Video motion data hidden from item multiedit
- Fix storyboard last page showing wrong items
- Storyboard is now refreshed automatically, when items are deleted, 
  added or moved
- Fixed many edge-cases with storyboards
- Google Drive integration for I2V

notes.title: v1.1.17 - More plugins :)
notes.notes:
- Cleanup to the plugin interface system (Steam users: update your plugins!!!)
- KlingAi plugin!!! The top of the line video service is finally at LVS
- Video plugins now give more info about the state of generation
- Application now tags the created video files

notes.title: v1.1.16
notes.notes:
v1.1.16
- Minimax / hailuo plugin! So, new integration to image / video services
  Update your plugins, check https://lyricvideo.studio for details
- Dynamic property view (plugins, multi edit) now supports lists
- Project archiving feature: you can now zip your project
  tight for archiving or easy sharing
- Track resizing is back, better than ever
- Color matrix effect now has sliders for RGBA for easier use
- Cancelling integrated SD generation now works better. Fix use case
  of having multiple instances of this plugin
- DreamMachine plugin supports now multiple character refs, up o 4
- Fixed issue where dropping image item to video track that is capable
  of importing image items, would still prompts for new track
- Content uploading works now with absolute paths
- Fixed video crossfade not working
- Fix issue where masking was not accurate when rendering project
  if render view was scaled down

notes.title: v1.1.15, minor fix patch
notes.notes:
- Auto-saves no longer crated if project did not change (idling)
- Esc now closes multi edit view and hotkeys work properly after
- Small fix to video item visualization in timeline
- Added iBarCount to to 'Bars 2' music visualization
- Fixed issue where audio track could not be unmuted after project load
- Fixed issue of cache rebuild not refreshing video length
  Also cache refreshing works more consistently
- Horizontal scrolling now possible in plugin item edit views

notes.title: v1.1.13
notes.notes:
v1.1.13
- Fixed path point editing not mathing cursor position on different alignments
- Fixed issue where items ending and starting at exact same location would
  render the previous item instead of next item
- Can now extract audio from clips that are shorter than original
- Fixed audio item visuals when start has been offsetted
- Frame rate now accepts decimals
- Fixed issue with Slow Motion not working properly
  if video item had been cut from the start
- Fixed issue where video items would be re-cached every time project loads
  Also fixe same issue woth slowed down videos
- Fixed issue where audio spectrum shader would get audio data from video
  when there would have been audio track as well
- Fixed issue where ffmpeg extracting was prematurely exited, fixed other sorts of
  ffmpeg rendering issues
- Fixed issue with 2160x3840 resolution not working
- Original file will no longer be renamed when new generation is done for image item
  This means that if image was used as source of video, it will no longer replace that
  one as well

notes.title: v1.1.9 - Slo Mo
notes.notes:
v1.1.9
- You can now do slow motion effects with video, see 
  "Slow motion" expander in video settings
- Allow text extraction from videos also
- Dream machine video upscale can now import videos from
  Dream machine video track
- Video rendering no longer generates extra blank frames
- Video rendering when opting for ffmpeg no longer cuts the video 1sec too short
- When generating content simulaneously and opening item for editing, any other that completes
  at same ti do not replace the image/video on opened item
- Can now invert selection and button for clearing selection
- Effect time selection now supports negative times: 
  set endMs to 0 and start ms to -200 to make the effect alwasy start 200ms 
  before the end. Endms also supports negative value
- Randomize start value no longer visible if transtion type 
  is not start -> end
- Randomize values are now separated for each effect loop
- 'Effect start' no longer showed if static time type selected

notes.title: v1.1.2
notes.notes:
- 4K support
- Color transfer
- A lot of fixes

notes.title: v1.0.44
notes.notes:
v1.0.44
- Story mode: Click the switch on bottom right of render screen to go to Story mode
  In that mode, you can select image tracks to display as grid view
- Amount of selected items now more visual
- Undo no longer pops up item edit, when item is brought back
- Image/video crossface no longer safe outs the item that is about to end
- Context size in LLM view now adjustable
- Fix issue of fade in not working in audio after adjusting start of audio
- Fix issue where small audio clips might now have been 
  rendered to final output, when playback markers were used
- Fix fade out not working while rendering
- Fixes to video start offsetting and looping, audio will no longer play
  when looped

notes.title: v1.0.41
notes.notes:
v1.0.41
- Importing video no longer popups up annoying screen
- Video thumbnails are refreshed when new generation is done
- Prompt history now works properly for plugins that are both image & video
  (luma ai plugin)
- Fix fade out when audio does not start from 0
- Fix audio file end visualization
- Undo now works for added and removed items (redo does not)

notes.title: v1.0.39
notes.notes:
- Image crop plugin now works better with large pictures
  Increased size of top left / bottom right markers
  Added frame to better show crop limits
  Adding 0 to width of height now scales preserving aspect ratio
- Esc now closes plugin edit views as well
- Fixed crash that could occur when multiple videos are being generated at once

notes.title: v1.0.38
notes.notes:
- Add audio fade in & out, select it from audio item properties
- Fixed issue with snapping also snapping the hover, which was not intented
- Can now change item start/end positions with right click contex menu
- Fixed visual cue of audio end drag, now in correct place if you have adjusted the
  beginning of audio item
- Snapping items with shift no longer randomly causes item to split

notes.title: v 1.0.36
notes.notes:
v1.0.36
- Quick Lyric Mode: CTRL + L to add new lyric item to last track (or last armed),
  to current playhead position. Opens popup to type in the text
- Also now you can paste stuff from clipboard to new tracks, with ctrl + V
  Works bit similar than Drag & drop, but creates new track every time
- When splitting, popup will open up, allowing you to choose how the words
  should be split between old and new. You can change thay behaviour in Settings.
  Choices are Ask (will show the popup), 50/50 (always split in the middle) or
  Duplicate (creates new item with same text)
- Popup view no longer full screen, closes with esc and no longer
  steals focus after closed, if it had text input (esc clears always the focus!)
- Users can now open image & plugin items to new window, right click on the item
  in timeline
- Integrated stable diffusion now supports video upscaling and img2img. See
  homepages for further instructions
- When changing scren size presets, render view is now refreshed immediately
  to right size
- When multiple items selected, prompt for confirmation
- Can now paste image items to plugin tracks that can import images
- Fixed issue with importing image items with relative source

notes.title: v1.0.33: Removing "annoyances"
notes.notes:
v1.0.33 (The annoyances-patch :) )
- Image & Video plugin items now show prompt in timeline
- App no longer crashes when trying to import text/images to track
  when no such tracks exists
- App now stores last selected item alignment and uses it as default for new
  items. This is saved per project
- Item panels no longer pop up if dragging items on timeline
- Device selection in LLM view is hidden when API is selected
- Added render quality for images. With this settings, you can improve
  the performance when on playback/editig. You can also choose lower
  quality for exporting, if you wish to make a preview etc. Chnage it from  
  project settings
- Can now use png file format when exporting. Temporary export files will
  be png files for better quality
- Timeline scale is back!
- Drag & Drop now works for multiple images as well: new video with
  image sequence is created

notes.title: v1.0.30: LLM++
notes.notes:
- LLM support ++: LLM support now includes more models
  View installs the necessary executable based on your choice. 
  Cuda & Cpu currently supported
- Integrated Stable diffusion support! Also for Steam users. 
  Same as in LLM, application installs required executable
  when first time generating images. Same story for cpu/gpu support. 
  Only Nvidia / cuda gpu supported

notes.title: v1.0.24 - The rise of the LLM
notes.notes:
You can now run Large Language Models in Lyric Video Studio locally! Mistral and phi-4 currently supported, DeepSeek support comig later. Other models may also work, but haven't been verified. 
Suggested use case: Import lyrics from track or paste to LLM view and generate image / video prompts and export then to track, thus almost completely automating the process

Also a lot of bug fixes agai, see full list from the app

- Select all as context menu item on track items

notes.title: v1.0.12
notes.notes:
- Added support of displaying timer or countdown in text, markdown is timer(mm\:ss:\ff) and countdown(mm\:ss:\ff). See homepages for better instructions, steam seems to change : \ to smileys :D
- Fixed project load issue if audio files was missing

- Object detection and motion tracking for videos

notes.notes:

- Esc closes also side panels

notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
1.0 Release is HERE! With new ui framework and NET9 update.
New major features: Whisper audio to txt integration and Fragment shaders!!! See the full list from the app

notes.title: v0.9.8
notes.notes:
v0.9.8
- You can now set video and image target width and height in multi-edit
  view in pixels. The app will calculate the scale for you
- Time-related settings now under project setting, not in timetrack
- Bigger font sizes no longer make the text path editing impossible
- Fixed the overlapping ui elements on path edit view
- Support for radial and sweep gradient
- When copying files to sub folder, failing to copy any cache item
  no longer fails the whole operation

notes.title: Update notes, 16.11.2024
notes.notes:
v0.9.6
- Opening an plugin item and closing it will no longer keep rendering
  it on top of others
- Blur effect now available to all track and item types
- Fixed crash when rendering project with multiple copies of same video
  Also fixes rendering crash when many plugins are in the project
- Item split hotkey is now 'Shift'
- Fixes to localizations

notes.notes: v0.9 is here. With lots's of improvements and new features, Lyric Video Studio is soon leaving early access, stay tuned!
